per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The dispute system UI should be consistent with corporate standards, including layout, fonts, and button placement.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All screens created as part of the Disputes application must comply with corporate standards for interface creation.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The dispute list should use color coding to distinguish between urgent, pending, and resolved cases.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The list of dispute cases that are displayed after a search is performed must be color coded for easy identification of dispute cases based upon the dispute case status.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Screen transitions should take no more than 5 seconds to avoid user frustration.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The maximum wait time for a user navigating from one screen to another within the Disputes application shall be no more than 5 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should automatically generate and send letters to the print utility without manual PDF creation.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall interface with the Letters application. This will allow the Disputes application to request letters as part of the dispute initiation and dispute follow up process. All letter requests must be sent to the Print Letter Utility application.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should reliably integrate with backend systems (statement, cardmember, merchant) to fetch transaction details and other data.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall interface with the Statement Database. The Statement Database provides the transaction details to the Disputes System. All transaction details must be obtained from the Statement Database'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should provide clear, non-cryptic error messages for system failures or backend timeouts.
The system should handle peak loads effectively, as experienced during high-traffic periods like busy Mondays.
The system should enforce role-based access control to restrict access to sensitive information based on user roles and assigned cardholder bases.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes System must prevent users from accessing any dispute cases that do not belong to their cardholder base.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should be available 24/7, with planned maintenance only during low-traffic hours (e.g., 3 AM–5 AM).

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should maintain comprehensive audit trails and logs to track changes for compliance and audits.
